about.label: About me
about.title: Who's behind the code
about.bio1: I'm a Brazilian full-stack developer with experience across projects of all scales — from institutional websites to complex SaaS platforms. I've worked at digital agencies and independently for clients across diverse industries.
about.bio2: I care about every detail: from backend architecture to the micro-animations that make interfaces feel fluid. I believe great software is that which solves real problems with elegance.
about.bio3: When I'm not coding, I'm studying design or exploring new technologies.
